findings.note: Denver's final report rules out All-Pro CB Pat Surtain II and starting S Talanoa Hufanga with ankle injuries, and lists CB Riley Moss (ribs) as questionable after he was limited all week and missed Week 5.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, who leads the NFL in receiving yards and TDs, practiced fully Wednesday and has no game status, so he is set to face Denver's weakened secondary; WR Irv Charles is on track to debut.

Seattle has ruled out starting LB Drake Thomas, with Tyrice Knight starting in his place, and RB Zach Charbonnet, while rookie RB Jadarian Price is on IR, leaving Emanuel Wilson and George Holani to lead an inconsistent run game.
